hack.root_cause: Off-chain Cloud Database Breach → Hot Wallet / Private Key Compromise
hack.description: Mixin Network, which markets itself as decentralized, lost $200M when its centralized cloud database — holding private key material — was breached, with funds swept via simple on-chain transfers requiring no smart contract exploit.

linked_factors.notes: Bug bounty absent — baseline integrity gap [via dashboard_risk_factors/Bug bounty: Unknown]
